episodes.title: Signs, Do You See Them?
episodes.description: Mother talks about the signs of God’s love that are all around us and discusses the ways that He has shown his love for us.

episodes.title: Saint Anthony
episodes.description: Mother talks about the greatness of St. Anthony.

episodes.title: Luke 7:36
episodes.description: Mother uses a reading from Luke 7:36 to talk about God's Mercy. If you forgive someone, God forgives you.

episodes.title: Holy Spirit
episodes.description: Mother talks about Pentecost and how the Holy Spirit dwells within us.

episodes.title: Obedience
episodes.description: St. John says if you say you do not commit sin you call God a liar. Whenever we are disobedient we buy into a lie. Mother talks about obedience.

episodes.title: John 21
episodes.description: Mother mentions the martyrs. From the Christians in the Coliseum to the martyr deaths of various popes, these Christians did not die for a memory but a living God--Jesus.

episodes.title: Personal Conversion
episodes.description: Mother talks about our conversion to Christ and the necessity of pursing holiness with zeal and unceasing prayer.

episodes.title: Elections
episodes.description: Mother Angelica discusses the important role Catholic voters play in national elections and in shaping the nation’s moral compass.

episodes.title: Speaking in Parables
episodes.description: Mother Angelica examines the topic of speaking in parables.

episodes.title: We Don'T See With Our Hearts
episodes.short: We Don'T See With Our Hearts
episodes.description: Mother reminds us that we need to see with our hearts, not our eyes in order for us to see the Hand of God at Work.

episodes.title: Reflection on the Passion
episodes.description: Mother Angelica reflects on the Passion of Christ.

episodes.title: Luke 12:46
episodes.description: Mother Angelica discusses Luke 12:46, illustrating how we will be prepared for what comes next.

episodes.title: Matthew 20 (World Is Tough Today)
episodes.description: Mother Angelica looks at Matthew 20, and how it illustrates how tough the world is today.

episodes.title: Psalms 46 and 51
episodes.description: Mother meditates on Psalms 46 in which we seek God as our refuge and strength and Psalm 51, when repentance should turn into humility of heart.

episodes.title: Psalms 50
episodes.description: Mother Angelica looks at Psalm 50, which addresses how God calls to everything on earth.

episodes.title: Dreams of St. John Bosco
episodes.description: Mother Angelica lends her insight into the dreams of Saint John Bosco.

episodes.title: Let Not Your Hearts Be Troubled
episodes.short: Let Not Your Hearts Be Troubled
episodes.description: Mother talks about tough times that people go through and though God allows difficulties in life, we can know that He will only do what is best for us.

episodes.title: The Paralytic
episodes.description: Mother discusses Jesus’ power to deliver us from those things which bind us down.

episodes.title: A Sign From Heaven
episodes.description: Mother talks about asking for signs from God and how the saints that live among us are signs from Heaven.

episodes.title: The Parable of the Wedding Feast
episodes.short: The Parable of the Wedding Feast
episodes.description: At each Mass, a wedding feast is taking place. Mother meditates on the parable, which our Lord compares to the kingdom of heaven.

episodes.title: Conscience
episodes.description: EWTN foundress Mother Angelica lends her valuable insight into the subject of conscience - why we have it, and what we do with it.

episodes.title: Feast of the Assumption
episodes.description: Mother focuses on the sinless and holy nature of Mary, her suffering with Christ on earth and its significance to our Faith.

episodes.title: First Beatitude and Hell
episodes.description: Mother discusses Hell, Purgatory and the first beatitude: to be poor in spirit.

episodes.title: Temple of the Holy Spirit
episodes.description: Mother Angelica lends her wisdom on a variety of topics, including the Temple of the Holy Spirit.

episodes.title: Road to Emmaus
episodes.description: Mother talks about how like the disciples on the road to Emmaus, we too don’t always recognize Jesus either.

episodes.title: 03/15/11 Suffering and Other Things
episodes.description: EWTN foundress Mother Angelica lends her insight to the subject of sufferring, and how our faith relates to how we handle it.

episodes.title: Ash Wednesday and Lent
episodes.description: Mother discusses Ash Wednesday and Lent and how penance helps us do good and avoid evil.

episodes.title: Psalms 139
episodes.description: Mother Angelica studies Psalms 139, which addresses how God knows all of us.

episodes.title: A Little Child Shall Lead Them
episodes.short: A Little Child Shall Lead Them
episodes.description: Mother Angelica teaches us to be like little children, using passages from Scripture to show the innocence and faith of the young in accepting the word of Jesus Christ.

episodes.title: What Is the Kingdom of Heaven Like
episodes.short: What Is the Kingdom of Heaven Like
episodes.description: Mother Angelica talks about what the Kingdom of Heaven might be like, and why we need to be like Jesus if we want to go there.

episodes.title: Where Is Prison
episodes.description: Mother discusses how those who do not know God are in a spiritual prison.

episodes.title: St. Matthew
episodes.description: St. Matthew was a different kind of tax collector – he was a thief. Mother discusses his life and how Our Lord continues to reach out to poor sinners like him.

episodes.title: Consequences of Sin
episodes.description: Mother discusses why sin has consequences, and what we can do to counter it.

episodes.title: Contemplative Life
episodes.description: Mother explains how prayerfully living the contemplative life allows God’s word to come through loud and clear.

episodes.title: Forgiveness
episodes.description: Mother explains why we can always ask for God’s Forgiveness as long as we are willing to forgive others and ourselves.

episodes.title: Gift of Knowledge
episodes.description: Mother discusses how according to some mystics the Lord will come one day and give us a warning - to see yourself as He sees you. You need light to know what’s wrong with you.

episodes.title: Wisdom (Understanding)
episodes.description: Mother tells the audience about the gift of Understanding, which allows us through faith to grasp what we do not comprehend.

episodes.title: Fortitude
episodes.description: Mother reveals how courage and endurance are all traits of the Holy Spirit’s gift of Fortitude.

episodes.title: Seven Gifts of Pentecost
episodes.description: Mother Angelica lends her insight on the seven gifts at Pentecost.

episodes.title: Excuses
episodes.description: Mother Angelica takes a look at, and lends insight into excuses - why we do it, who benefits, and the consequences of it.

episodes.title: Saint Peter and the Resurrection
episodes.description: Mother explains Our Lord's choice in Peter.

episodes.title: Lenten Observations
episodes.description: Mother Angelica looks at Lenten observations, lending her wit and wisdom along the way.

episodes.title: The Church
episodes.description: Mother discusses the devil's jealousy of God because he would not worship Him as a man This is no different than today because we see the same problems.

episodes.title: What Will You Give Christ for Christmas
episodes.short: What Will You Give Christ for Christmas
episodes.description: The wisdom of Mother Angelica lives on as she asks Catholics to remember not only Jesus, but His Mother Mary as well, when deciding what gifts to give this Christmas.

episodes.title: Christmas
episodes.description: Mother Angelica talks about the increasing secularization of Christmas and reminds us of Christmas' true meaning by understanding the Nativity story.

episodes.title: Our Lady's Yes
episodes.description: Using Our Lady as an example, Mother Angelica talks about how we must trust in God but also that God trusts us with regard to the talents and responsibilities he gives us.

episodes.title: God Answered Their Prayers
episodes.description: Mother talks about examples where God has answered prayers in sometimes strange or unseen ways.

episodes.title: How to Read the Bible
episodes.description: Mother reads passages from Mark’s Gospel and encourages viewers to use their imaginations to vividly picture what is being read.

episodes.title: God as Father
episodes.description: Mother says that she has a difficult time having a father figure because her father was not around. Those who were abused and have a hard time thinking of God as Father. We should never be afraid of the Father.

episodes.title: Angels
episodes.description: Mother discusses about archangels and guardian angels and how they aid us in our daily battles against fallen angels, also known as devils.

episodes.title: St. Paul and the Folded Tent
episodes.short: St. Paul and the Folded Tent
episodes.description: Mother Angelica uses her wit and wisdom as she examines the story of St. Paul and the folded tent.

episodes.title: Seven Sorrows
episodes.description: Mother offers a moving reflection on the Seven Sorrows of Our Lady, what they can teach us in our own lives and how it played a special role in her vocation.

episodes.title: Our Lady
episodes.description: Mother discusses the holiness of Mary. She was destined by God to be the Mother of the Son of God. Therefore, she was not blemished with sin.

episodes.title: Mark 4
episodes.description: Mother reflects from Mark about the two parables on the Sower and the Seed.The seed that is being sowed is the Word of God.

episodes.title: Silence of Heart and Mind
episodes.description: Mother Angelica discusses silence of the heart and of the mind.

episodes.title: Pride, Charity and Justice
episodes.description: Mother guides her viewers on how to counter pride with charity and justice.

episodes.title: Mary's Trust and Corpus Christi
episodes.description: Mother Angelica lends her wisdom into Mary's trust and Corpus Christi.

episodes.title: Why Did Lucifer Call God a Liar
episodes.short: Why Did Lucifer Call God a Liar
episodes.description: Mother Angelica offers an insightful discussion on the deceptiveness of our spiritual enemy, Satan.

episodes.title: 2 Corinthians 3:18
episodes.description: God Himself is love and mercy. Mother tells us how we must seek to be transformed into Christ by living His way.

episodes.title: Difficult Parables
episodes.description: Some parables can be difficult to interpret. Mother explains them as means to help us think the way God does.

episodes.title: 1 Kings 18 - Elijah
episodes.description: Mother reflects on how God comes to us in silent prayer just as He came to Elijah in the whispering breeze.

episodes.title: Heaven and Angels
episodes.description: Mother discusses the unimaginable wonder and beauty of heaven and the angels and how the way to get there is through repentance.

episodes.title: To Understand Is to Know Christ's Love
episodes.short: To Understand Is to Know Christ's Love
episodes.description: Mother Angelica looks at Christ's love, and demonstrates that understanding is knowing His love.

episodes.title: Tribute to Mother Teresa
episodes.description: Mother talks about the “real” Mother Teresa and how her love of Christ and the Eucharist can help guide our lives.

episodes.title: Works of Mercy
episodes.description: Mother talks about the corporal and spiritual works of mercy and how to live out these works in our daily lives.

episodes.title: This Is a Wicked Age
episodes.description: Mother reads from Scripture where St. Paul says that “this is a wicked age but your lives shall redeem it" and explains that if we are to follow God, we should bring people back to Him.

episodes.title: A Blueprint for Life
episodes.description: Mother shows us how just like the plans in building a house, it is a necessity of having a blueprint for a spiritual life.

episodes.title: Will of God in Every Vocation
episodes.short: Will of God in Every Vocation
episodes.description: Mother explains how we can serve God no matter what our vocation in life.

episodes.title: Luke 19
episodes.description: From a glimpse on a Sycamore tree, Zaccaheus saw Jesus only once and was converted instantly. Yet we go to Mass regularly, even everyday and not have that same experience. Mother tells us we have to change.

episodes.title: I AM His Temple
episodes.description: Mother describes the fruits and gifts of the Holy Spirit and how they can help us better understand the Third Person of the Trinity.

episodes.title: Fear
episodes.description: Mother explains that despite the fears in the world today we should always rely on Our Lord and His Providence. As Catholics, there is no use for fear.

episodes.title: Psalms
episodes.description: Mother goes over the Psalms. She reflects on Psalm 139 which praises the omnipotence of God as how much God loves us. A meditation from Psalm 113 and how it relates to modern issues like abortion.

episodes.title: St. Joseph
episodes.description: Mother discusses St. Joseph and how he is such a "powerful saint" and patron of the universal Church. He has everything to teach our families how to be a family.

episodes.title: Why Is It You Have No Faith
episodes.short: Why Is It You Have No Faith
episodes.description: 'Why are you so frightened? Have you still no faith? Mother reads from Mark 4 and uses the passage where Jesus calms the seas as a meditation on faith.

episodes.title: Thoughts for All Times
episodes.description: Mother addresses some of the fallacies that certain movements have perpetuated in modern society.

episodes.title: Spiritual Blindness (Call to Holiness)
episodes.description: Mother Angelica reflects on how we can overcome our blindness and become holy.

episodes.title: Shopping and Spirituality
episodes.description: Looking at statues should remind us that all the saints were like us . Mother asks the audience to shop for holy reminders.

episodes.title: The Inward Struggle
episodes.description: Mother discusses the classic and constant inner struggle of doing the things we don't like and not doing the things we do like, just as St. Paul did.

episodes.title: Rash Judgment
episodes.description: Mother looks to the Scriptures and talks about how rash judgments we make lead us away from God. But He is always willing to forgive us when we turn back to him.

episodes.title: Odds and Ends
episodes.description: Mother Angelica lends her perspective on a variety of topics, focusing on the "odds and ends" of our Faith.

episodes.title: Catholic Epistles
episodes.description: Mother explores the wisdom and instruction found in the Epistles.

episodes.title: Scapular and St. James
episodes.description: Our Lady gave St. Simon Stock the Brown Scapular, which is a promise that those in a state of grace wearing it will be saved. Mother talks about the Scapular's history.

episodes.title: Modesty
episodes.description: Mother explains the virtue of modesty and how as God's temple, we should be well-informed on the way we dress.

episodes.title: True Friendship
episodes.description: Mother assures us that God calls us ultimately not to be His servant, but to be His friends. Next to Him, we have a friend in Mary as well.

episodes.title: Revelation - First Three Chapters
episodes.description: Mother guides the audience on a look at the first three chapters of Revelation.

episodes.title: Bad Things Happen
episodes.description: Mother talks about how we need to be poor in spirit and realize that suffering is not about pain it is an opportunity to be like Jesus.

episodes.title: Miracles of Jesus
episodes.description: Mother reflects on the miracles of Jesus and discusses the Sacrament of Penance.

episodes.title: Imperfection as an Opportunity
episodes.description: We should never feel discouraged for being imperfect. Mother reminds us that Jesus came for the sinner not the virtuous – he came for you specifically because you are imperfect.

episodes.title: Poor Sinners
episodes.description: Mother assures those who have not been to Confession to be not afraid and that God is waiting for you there with His love and mercy.

episodes.title: Walking on Water
episodes.description: Mother likens belief in the Eucharist to walking on water. We must be willing to walk by Faith.

episodes.title: Compassion
episodes.description: Mother talks about the beauty of the virtue of Compassion. She discusses Luke 6:36.

episodes.title: Resolutions
episodes.description: Mother Angelica talks about New Year’s resolutions and what it is we should truly resolve to do from a spiritual perspective for the coming year.

episodes.title: Purgatory and God's Will
episodes.description: Mother Angelica lends her wisdom and insight into the subject of Purgatory and God's will.

episodes.title: Hope
episodes.description: Mother Angelica explains the difference between natural hope and supernatural hope

episodes.title: Light and Darkness
episodes.description: EWTN foundress Mother Angelica discusses light and darkness, as it relates to the Church.

episodes.title: Zacchaeus
episodes.description: Mother shares the story of Zacchaeus' encounter with Jesus, an example showing how some people may have a lot of knowledge but very little in knowing God.

episodes.title: Jeremiah
episodes.description: Mother discusses the prophet Jeremiah and how his story should affect us in how we live our lives.

episodes.title: Wisdom
episodes.description: Without God, we cannot make a right decision. Mother meditates on the Book of Wisdom Ch. 7: 15-21.

episodes.title: Woman at the Well
episodes.description: Mother recounts the story of Jesus talking to the woman at the well and what insights this story can give to us.

episodes.title: Mark 6:30
episodes.description: God can ask us to do the impossible. Mother uses the Gospel of Mark to show us that all things are possible with God.
